hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Caribbean, western one-third of the island of Hispaniola, between the Caribbean Sea and the North Atlantic Ocean, west of the Dominican Republic || mostly rough and mountainous || shares island of Hispaniola with Dominican Republic (western one-third is Haiti, eastern two-thirds is the Dominican Republic); it is the most mountainous nation in the Caribbean || Resources: bauxite, copper, calcium carbonate, gold, marble, hydropower, arable land || Exports: garments, essential oils, scrap iron, industrial acids/oils/alcohols, bedding (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: mostly rough and mountainous || Caribbean, western one-third of the island of Hispaniola, between the Caribbean Sea and the North Atlantic Ocean, west of the Dominican Republic

climate.excerpt: tropical; semiarid where mountains in east cut off trade winds || lies in the middle of the hurricane belt and subject to severe storms from June to October; occasional flooding and earthquakes; periodic droughts

economy.excerpt: small Caribbean island economy and OECS-member state; extreme poverty and inflation; enormous income inequality; ongoing civil unrest due to recent presidential assassination; US preferential market access; very open to foreign direct investment || Exports: garments, essential oils, scrap iron, industrial acids/oils/alcohols, bedding (2023) || Industries: textiles, sugar refining, flour milling, cement, light assembly using imported parts
